name: May 26, 2022 Special Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  MALIBU PUBLIC FACILITIES AUTHORITY MEETING
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MAY 26, 2022
  TELECONFERENCED – VARIOUS LOCATIONS
  1:00 P.M.

The following meeting was held pursuant to AB 361 and fully teleconferenced from
various locations during the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic.

CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Greenstein called the meeting to order at 1:02 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance:

  PRESENT: Chair Nancy Greenstein; and Commissioners Margaret Quińones-
  Perez and Paul Grisanti

  ABSENT:  Commissioner Bruce Silverstein

  ALSO PRESENT: Technical Advisory Committee (TAC) Members Steve
  McClary, City of Malibu (Malibu) City Manager, and Dr. Kathryn Jeffery, Santa
  Monica College (SMC) Superintendent/President; Joe Toney, Assistant City
  Manager; Ruthie Quinto, Malibu Interim Assistant City Manager/City Treasurer;
  Donald Girard, SMC Senior Director of Government Relations and Institutional
  Relations; Chris Bonvenuto, SMC Vice President of Administration and Business
  Services; Charlie Yen, SMC Director of Facilities Planning; Yu-Ngok Lo, Assistant
  Director of Facilities Planning Construction; Maral Hyeler, Director, SMC
  Instructional Services & External Programs; Shari Davis, Project Manager, SMC
  Special Projects; Elizabeth Shavelson, Malibu Deputy City Manager Shavelson;
  Richard Mollica, Planning Director; Rob DuBoux, Public Works Director; Yolanda
  Bundy, Environmental Sustainability Director; Adrian Fernandez, Assistant
  Planning Director; Parker Davis, Malibu Media Technician; and Mary Linden,
  Malibu Executive Assistant

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Mayor Grisanti moved, and Commissioner Quińones-Perez seconded a
  motion to approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion
  carried 3-0, Commissioner Silverstein absent.
   Malibu Public Facilities Authority

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Malibu Executive Assistant Linden reported that the agenda for the meeting was
  properly posted on May 20, 2022.

ITEM 1A  PUBLIC COMMENTS

  Kay Gabbard, Malibu Community Labor Exchange (MCLE) Board
  Member, expressed pleasure with the construction progress. She stated
  MCLE looked forward to learning whatever spot was chosen for the MCLE
  trailer. She stated they look forward to establishing a strong relationship
  with SMC.

ITEM 1B  COMMISSIONER COMMENTS

  TAC Member McClary introduced the new Malibu Assistant City Manager
  Joe Toney.

  Mr. Toney stated he was happy to be in Malibu and that he was always
  available.

ITEM 2  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Commissioner Quińones-Perez moved, and Commissioner Grisanti
  seconded a motion to approve the Consent Calendar. The question was
  called, and the motion carried 3-0, Commissioner Silverstein absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following item:

  A.  Approval of Minutes
  Recommended action: Approve minutes of the Malibu Public
  Facilities Authority meeting of March 16, 2022.

ITEM 3  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

ITEM 4  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Santa Monica College Malibu Campus Community Outreach
  Recommended Action: Receive an update and provide additional feedback
  on Santa Monica College’s (SMC) assessment of community interest in
  educational programs and hosted events at the new SMC Malibu Campus.

  SMC Senior Director Girard introduced the report. He stated 60,000
  postcards were mailed to residents of Malibu, Agoura Hills, and
   Malibu Public Facilities Authority

  Page 3 of 3
  __________________________

  unincorporated Los Angeles County and Topanga. He discussed newspaper
  ads placed throughout the region, and that the Malibu Chamber of
  Commerce, City of Malibu Public Information Office and Santa Monica-
  Malibu Unified School District (SMMUSD) helped get the word out about
  the survey. He stated a second postcard would go out shortly. He stated
  SMC was working with KBUU radio on routine announcements about the
  survey and future programming. He introduced Maral Hyeler, Director of
  SMC Instructional Services & External Programs.

  Director Hyeler provided a presentation on the results of the survey.

  B.  Update on Santa Monica College Malibu Campus and Los Angeles County
  Sheriff Substation
  Recommended Action: Receive and file an update on the Santa Monica
  College Malibu Campus and Los Angeles County Sheriff Substation
  project. This project is not funded by the City of Malibu.

  SMC Director Yen provided a presentation on the status of the project.

ITEM 5  COMMISSIONER ITEMS

  None.

ITEM 6  CLOSED SESSION

  None.

ADJOURNMENT

CONSENSUS
  At 1:26 p.m., Commissioner Quińones-Perez moved, and Commissioner Grisanti
  seconded a motion to adjourn the meeting. The question was called, and the motion
  carried 3-0, Commissioner Silverstein absent.

  Approved and adopted by the Malibu Public
  Facilities Authority on July 28, 2022.

  NANCY GREENSTEIN, Chair
ATTEST:
